follow-up time: Variable, until resolution or treatment of enhanced myometrial vascularity/arteriovenous malformations
outcome: Resolution of enhanced myometrial vascularity/arteriovenous malformations
Need for intervention (uterine artery embolization, hysterectomy)
Peak systolic velocity in arteriovenous malformations
cohort: 27 patients diagnosed with uterine enhanced myometrial vascularity/arteriovenous malformations by transvaginal ultrasound
finding: Transvaginal ultrasound is effective in diagnosing and monitoring enhanced myometrial vascularity/arteriovenous malformations, and treatment decisions based on clinical status and blood flow velocity measurements can guide appropriate management.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as a potential risk factor for acquired enhanced myometrial vascularity/arteriovenous malformations.
